description: Where a detector keeps the code that raises each finding code. detector_emitter.py finds the finding's code in the codes table, reads the source file and line it names, and hands that excerpt to evidence extraction and planning: the checker's own conditions and comments at the reporting site, which say what a fix has to change. A local checkout ($home_env/checkout_path) is read first; otherwise url_template at the pinned revision. A detector is added here, not in code.
